title: Spikers' Turf: Savouge turns back VNS-Laticrete, extends win streak to 3 games
summary: Savouge overcame a challenge from VNS-Laticrete on their way to a 25-10, 25-13, 20-25, 25-19 in the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan.
